g.text: L298N carrier: IN1, IN2, ENA, VSS, VS, GND, OUT1, OUT2

g.desc: L298N carrier: IN1, IN2, ENA, VSS, VS, GND, OUT1, OUT2

g.text: J1 is a logical carrier connector in the listed pin order. Uno D2/D3 set direction, D9/OC1A drives ENA PWM, and Uno 5 V supplies VSS only after the carrier regulator is disabled as its documentation requires.

g.desc: J1 is a logical carrier connector in the listed pin order. Uno D2/D3 set direction, D9/OC1A drives ENA PWM, and Uno 5 V supplies VSS only after the carrier regulator is disabled as its documentation requires.

g.text: J2 pin 1 supplies VS from a motor-rated external supply; pin 2 is ground. Remove/disable the carrier regulator jumper before connecting Uno 5 V to VSS. Verify the board has the required inductive-load diodes. Do not use a motor whose stall current exceeds the carrier or thermal design. This drawing is logical, not a physical test.

g.desc: J2 pin 1 supplies VS from a motor-rated external supply; pin 2 is ground. Remove/disable the carrier regulator jumper before connecting Uno 5 V to VSS.
